result.stdout:
Description:
  Measures the speed of the CryptoBase algorithms.

Usage:
  cryptobase-speedtest [<algorithm>...] [command] [options]

Arguments:
  <algorithm>  Algorithms to run: names, patterns with * and ?, group names, or 'all' (the default).

Options:
  -s, --seconds <seconds>            Measuring time of each cell, in seconds. [default: 0.2]
  -w, --warmup <warmup>              Least warm-up time of each row, or of each operation, in seconds. The warm-up goes on until the JIT, if any, has compiled nothing for a while, up to 5 s longer, or 10 s with one processor; 0 skips it. [default: 0.5]
  -b, --bytes <size>                 Input sizes of the throughput groups, in bytes, with an optional k or m suffix (x1024). [default: 16|64|256|1024|8192|16384]
  --decrypt                          Measure decryption instead of encryption for ciphers that have both.
  -t, --threads <n>                  Threads that each run their own workload at the same time; the rates are their sum. At most 16, four per logical processor. [default: 1]
  -f, --format <json|markdown|text>  Output format: text tables, Markdown tables, or a JSON document at the end with progress on standard error. [default: text]
  --test                             Instead of measuring, check every workload once: each operation, decryption too, at each input size. Ignores --seconds, --warmup, --decrypt, --threads and --format.
  -?, -h, --help                     Show help and usage information
  --version                          Show version information

Commands:
  list <pattern>  List the algorithms with their groups and operations.
  info            Show the runtime, the processor and its instruction sets in full.
